description: Current service status for London transport lines. Pass either a comma-separated list of modes (e.g. "tube,dlr") OR a specific lineId (e.g. "victoria", "central"). Returns each line with lineStatuses + statusSeverityDescription (e.g. "Good Service", "Minor Delays").

lineId.description: Specific line id, e.g. "victoria", "central", "elizabeth". Takes precedence over modes.

modes.description: Comma-separated transport modes: tube, dlr, overground, elizabeth-line, bus, tram, national-rail. Used when lineId is not given.

name: line_status
